name: Arcane Literacy
description: You see what a site is from 5 tiles away instead of 3, and what kind of reward it holds.

name: Scrying Lens
description: Every unknown site within 8 tiles of you becomes known.

name: Identify
description: Reveal a visible combat site's full composition before engaging. It is a scout report without stepping onto the hex, and the forces it shows are the forces you fight.

name: Ley Tap
description: While on Arcane Ground: spend half a day for 2 Essence.
